run.rules_text: Legacy v4 checks every 0100/0200 in this order: unknown card -> 14; blocked card -> 62; expired card -> 54; incorrect PIN -> 55; issuer glitch -> 96; duplicate (same card, STAN and amount within 60 seconds) -> 94; balance below amount -> 51; otherwise approve 00 and debit. 0400 reversals: original not found or not approved -> 25; already reversed -> 94; otherwise credit back 00.
run.spec_text: ISO 8583 (ASCII). MTI 0100 auth, 0200 purchase, 0400 reversal. Fields: 2 card number, 3 processing code, 4 amount (12 digits, cents), 7 transmission time MMDDhhmmss, 11 STAN, 14 expiry YYMM, 18 MCC, 22 entry mode, 37 retrieval ref, 39 response code, 41 terminal id, 48 private data, 49 currency (840 = USD).

triage.summary_md:
## Duplicate purchases are charged twice on NewSwitch v1

**Severity:** critical · **Rule:** Reject a duplicate purchase (same card, STAN and amount within 60 seconds)

The new switch approves a retried purchase that the legacy switch rejects with **94 Duplicate transmission**.
Both legacy copies (Old A and Old B) agree, so this is not noise.

| Retry gap | Old A | Old B | New |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 s | 94 | 94 | 94 |
| 0.5 s | 94 | 94 | 94 |
| 1 s | 94 | 94 | **00** |
| 5 s | 94 | 94 | **00** |
| 59 s | 94 | 94 | **00** |
| 61 s | 00 | 00 | 00 |

### Boundary
- Retries **1 second or more** apart are approved and debited a second time.
- Retries inside the same second are still caught.
- After 60 seconds both switches agree (new purchase).

### Root-cause hypothesis
The 60-second duplicate window appears to be read as **60 milliseconds** (`dup_window` unit mismatch).

### Money at risk
In the 2,000 replayed transactions, 41 regressions totaling `$6,874.12` would have been double-charged.

_Data is IBM TabFormer (public synthetic benchmark). The defect was seeded for this demo._
triage.affected_rule: Reject a duplicate purchase (same card, STAN and amount within 60 seconds)
triage.root_cause_hypothesis: Duplicate window of 60 is interpreted as milliseconds, so retries 1 s or more apart are treated as new purchases.

decision.note: Duplicate retries are double-charged. Blocking until fixed and re-tested.
